settings.queue_realtime_help: Off by default: pushes run in the request, so messages arrive immediately. Turn this on only if your forum runs a continuous queue worker, or if the web server cannot reach the websocket daemon. With Flarum's database queue driver the worker runs once a minute, which will delay every message by up to that long.
